text: Мне очень понравилось! Я была у гинеколога Татьяны Сосновской и осталась в полном восторге! И по стилю общения, и по вниманию к особенностям пациента, и по вдумчивому отношению к данным, и по тому, как проводился осмотр и давались рекомендации-доктор просто супер! Да и стиль общения сразу был задан такой, что прошёл и страх, и волнение (а их было очень много!) Спасибо ещё раз прекрасному врачу и клинике!
Kvantni pregled na vrhunskom nivou.

I see that this polyclinic has good reviews, which I personally strongly doubt. First of all, the facility does not look like a proper or professional medical practice at all.

Now to my experience: I went there last year to see a private infectious disease specialist because I had been suffering from severe lower abdominal pain for more than a week. I was in a very bad condition, you could clearly see it in my face, and I was literally bent over in pain. An ultrasound was done, and I was told that nothing could be seen.

When I tried to explain my symptoms, the doctor did not even let me finish a single sentence. He kept interrupting me, repeatedly saying: “Sweetheart, it’s impossible that you’re in pain, that’s medically impossible.” Instead, he claimed I had depression and prescribed me Bromazepam, telling me to just rest.

When I showed him my extremely bloated abdomen, he said he couldn’t tell whether I was simply fat or if my stomach was actually bloated. We are talking about a doctor.

When I asked whether blood tests, stool tests, or any kind of lab work could be done, he told me they do not do that there and that I should go to a lab myself.

I then forced myself to go to a laboratory. The next day, with the last of my strength, I went to the emergency room. After a long wait, I had to undergo emergency surgery. I was told that if I had arrived just one hour later, I likely would not be alive today.

What started as an undiagnosed appendicitis turned into a ruptured appendix. I then spent three months in the hospital.

If this doctor had at least let me speak or taken me seriously, he should have known that appendicitis is not always visible on an ultrasound. My condition alone should have been enough to immediately refer me to the emergency room.

Instead, I was constantly addressed as “sweetheart,” dismissed, and told that I didn’t need to explain anything because he was the doctor and knew better, and that my pain was “medically impossible.”

I strongly advise against this clinic, especially the infectious disease department.

I live abroad and was only visiting Montenegro. I have never experienced anything like this before and I am extremely grateful to live in the European Union and receive proper medical care.
